notes: SHIP v1.14.421 - P3 OF PHASE-ENGINE: THE STEP MODEL AND ITS STATE MACHINE. No UI surface. This completes PHASE-ENGINE, workstream 1 of the governing spec. STEPS HANG BENEATH THE PHASES THAT ALREADY EXIST. DEPLOY_PHASE_TYPES - mechanical, power, network, compute, validation - is already the app phase taxonomy, already driving labels, colours, gating and the phase matrix. The spec examples use ids like P4, and inventing a second P1-to-P5 vocabulary beside the existing five would be exactly the duplicate-concept failure this programme exists to delete, and it would look perfectly fine in a screenshot. So a step id is phaseType-Snn and the phase it belongs to is one of the five that already exist. A test pins the two lists as equal: if they ever diverge, the app has two answers to what a phase is. PROVENANCE IS NOT DECORATION. Spec section 6.1 says a model built from Master workflow data is source MASTER and one built from site defaults is SITE_TEMPLATE, described as your site template and NEVER phrased as if the customer Master specified it. Measured against the live parser: PHANTOM Master carries cabs, hosts, cables and SITE-VARS, and no step-level workflow whatsoever. So today every model is SITE_TEMPLATE, it is STORED saying so rather than inferred at read time, and a test asserts it never claims MASTER. THE STEP TEXT IS DELIBERATELY A PLACEHOLDER, AND THAT IS AN HONESTY DECISION. Real per-platform commissioning procedure is site knowledge this code does not have. Shipping thirty invented steps that LOOK authoritative would be fabricated telemetry wearing a checklist - the operator would read procedure nobody wrote. Each template seeds one step per real phase, labelled step not yet defined for this site, and expectScan is null rather than a guess, because a wrong scan expectation misroutes a real scan. The Site Lead fills in real procedure later. An empty honest model beats a full invented one. THE INVARIANT, ENFORCED RATHER THAN TRUSTED. Section 6.2 says a BLOCKED step REQUIRES a blockerId referencing a real Blocker record, and that a blocked step without one is an invalid state. transition() REJECTS that move and writes nothing - not written-then-repaired - and the rejection says WHY, because it did not work is not something a technician in an aisle can act on. This is what P2 built the record for. Clearing a block returns the step to IN_PROGRESS and CLOSES the record without deleting it. COMPLETE credits the ACTOR from the profile, never the Site Lead. Every transition writes a STEP_STATE_CHANGE v2 event carrying rack, stepId and the from-to summary: a step that moved with no event is a step nobody can account for. Four named states, no booleans; an unknown state is rejected rather than stored. The new store is registered for backup, because step state and evidence are the operator work. TESTS: new spec 13-phase-model.spec.js, thirteen tests, all green. GATES: 3 inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, braces balanced, CRLF intact, three-stamp lockstep, enforced by the commit hook. No RACK SCENE LOCK term touched. ?legacy=1 unaffected. DEVICE-VERIFY: no visible surface yet - nothing renders the model until a later workstream. Confirm v1.14.421 and confirm nothing changed. In the console, PHANTOM_PHASE_MODEL.template(H100).source must read SITE_TEMPLATE.
